as_told.title: SAR scan of the Great Pyramid showing the Grand Gallery and the big void

plain: A team scanning the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt with satellite radar, which builds pictures of hidden structures from radar echoes, says it found the Big Void, a large empty space inside the pyramid, lying crosswise from east to west. A researcher named Filippo Biondi says this, describing work he took part in with a colleague he calls Corrado: "we have detected the big void also." In a second telling Biondi stresses that "these are not simulated data," adds that they also picked up the Grand Gallery, the long sloping passage inside the pyramid, and dates the work to 2018 to 2020.
